title: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

reading.body:
This incident shows a generative image model being used to create non-consensual intimate imagery from a real person's private photographs. The failure occurs at the content generation stage, before any distribution, where the system produced explicit images without the person's consent.

The failure mode is misuse of a generative AI system for image-based sexual abuse, compounded by distribution through fake accounts. Catching this would have required the generation tool to detect and refuse requests that combine a real person's face with explicit content, or to require proof of consent before producing such images.

What is not established is which AI tool was used, whether its operator had any safeguards, or whether Bansal has been convicted; the reports describe an arrest and an admission, not a legal finding.

reports.title: Delhi: Man held for circulating obscene AI-generated photos of college acquaintance
Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

summary:
A 22-year-old man named Keshav Bansal was arrested in Delhi for creating and sharing artificial intelligence-generated obscene images of a college acquaintance. Bansal, a BTech graduate in Electronics and Communication Engineering from East Punjabi Bagh, obtained photographs from the woman's private social media account and used AI technology to create morphed explicit images. He then distributed this content through multiple fake accounts on Instagram, Discord, and Facebook while using various Gmail addresses to hide his identity.

The victim, also 22 years old, discovered the harassment when she received messages from anonymous Instagram accounts informing her that her altered photographs and videos were circulating on Discord servers. She reported the matter to the Cyber Police Station in North Delhi. During their investigation, police analyzed digital footprints and traced the fake accounts to Bansal. He admitted during questioning that personal resentment from college had motivated his actions, and that after he uploaded the initial content, other unknown users created additional explicit images that he then reposted. Police recovered his mobile phone, two SIM cards, and other digital evidence.
